info.title: Atlas Stats API
info.description: The Atlas Stats API provides access to a wide range of statistical data, including GDP, population, and other key indicators for countries around the world. This API is designed to be fast, reliable, and easy to use, making it an ideal choice for developers looking to integrate statistical data into their applications.

get.description: Returns a list of the user's API key metadatas.

post.description: Rotates an existing API key, returning a new raw key.
